grammar.summary: 本课学习表任务的 task 语义与 It was not until...that。

points.title: It was not until...that 强调句
points.explanation: It was not until the helicopter arrived that they were rescued. "直到……才"的强调形式：It is not until + 时间 + that + 主句。

examples.en: It was not until the arrival of helicopters that flying became routine.
examples.cn: 直到直升机出现，飞行才变得寻常。

points.title: 表「伴随」的 while doing 复现
points.explanation: carrying heavy loads while flying 飞行任务描写中分词伴随复现。

examples.en: Birds can fly because their bones are hollow.
examples.cn: 鸟能飞是因为骨头是空心的。
